title: Newport from the back window
logline: The town through the bus's rear window, going away: the bridge, the bay, the lights, the frame of the window around it, an empty seat's headrest in the corner. He never saw the town leave. He draws it leaving.

panels.composition: A bus's rear window with a small coastal town going away in it, a bridge and bay and a few lights, an empty seat's headrest in the corner of the frame.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus's rear window framing a small coastal town receding with a bridge and a bay and a few lights, an empty seat's headrest in the frame's corner, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
